credits.name: Isometric Landscape, Isometric City and Isometric Buildings
credits.author: Kenney Vleugels (www.kenney.nl)
credits.changes: Tiles are layered into whole buildings, quads and lots, then packed into one atlas. Lawn tiles are brightened.

credits.name: Nature Kit, Furniture Kit and Platformer Kit
credits.author: Kenney Vleugels (www.kenney.nl)
credits.changes: Trees, bushes, flowers and benches are shrunk to the map's scale. Leaves are recoloured from teal to green, and one tree to blossom pink. Soft shadows are added.

credits.name: Mini Characters
credits.author: Kenney Vleugels (www.kenney.nl)
credits.changes: The 3D characters are rendered to small walking sprites from the map's camera angle. Soft shadows are added.
